name: devon_park
title: Staff Backend Engineer
job_desc:
Staff Backend Engineer, Payments Platform - Paystream (Remote, US)
Paystream moves billions in card and bank payments. We need a staff engineer to set technical direction for our payments platform.
What you'll do: design and evolve distributed systems for authorization, clearing and settlement; lead event-driven architecture on Kafka; raise reliability and observability standards; mentor senior and mid-level engineers; lead system design reviews; participate in on-call.
What we look for: 8+ years backend engineering; Go or Python; Kafka; Kubernetes; PostgreSQL; AWS; payments or fintech experience; Terraform a plus; gRPC a plus.

interview.question: Describe a technical decision you made that you would make differently today.
interview.answer: We moved to Kafka for the ledger and it went fine but it took long. Maybe I would plan more. Also we had some issues with consumers but we fixed them.

facts: The payments service processes about 3 million card and ACH transactions a day, roughly $40M in volume.
The ledger migration to Kafka finished with zero downtime and no lost transactions; it let the team ship ledger changes weekly instead of monthly.
Pages for the payments on-call fell from about 120 a month to about 70 a month after the runbooks and alert cleanup.
The p99 latency work on the authorization API cut timeouts at checkout by about half.
Two of the three junior engineers Devon mentored were promoted to mid-level within 18 months.
The shipment tracking APIs at ShipFast handled about 5 million requests a day.
The Airflow ETL jobs replaced a manual weekly export and saved the analytics team about 10 hours a week.
